key_difference: (B) puts the QThreadData::currentThreadData() guard inside a new QThreadStorageData::clear(), so clearLocalData() is safe during shutdown and never re-creates thread-local storage. (D) calls d.set(nullptr) unconditionally, which can re-create and leak TLS at shutdown, leaves the guard (and the qthread_p.h dependency) at the qcollator call site, and documents clearLocalData() as unsafe at shutdown.
